name: United℠ Gateway Card

welcome_offer.description: Earn up to 50,000 bonus miles: 40,000 bonus miles after you spend $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months, plus 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months.
notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02 shows "Earn up to 40,000 (struck) 50,000 bonus miles".

other_benefits.name: Expanded Award Availability
other_benefits.description: Access to expanded United MileagePlus award availability

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: $0 annual fee; up to 50,000 bonus miles (40k after $1,000 in 3 months + 10k for adding an authorized user).

notes: Entry-level United co-brand card with $0 AF. Lower earning rates and fewer perks than Explorer or Club cards. The 2x on gas + transit + United is decent but not exceptional. No checked bag benefit or lounge passes. Best as a supplement for non-frequent United flyers who want to earn miles without paying an AF.
